nodes.name: Practiced Edge
nodes.description: 15% more damage. Bonuses apply per rank.

nodes.name: Readied Cleave
nodes.description: Landed Cleaves build a separate cycle on each target: 10% increased damage per stack, up to 4. The fourth hit receives its full bonus, then resets that target’s stacks.

nodes.name: Deep Notches
nodes.description: Reaching maximum Readied Cleave stacks grants Berserk for 4 seconds: 15% more attack damage, 10% increased attack speed and 3% life leech.

nodes.name: Barbed Edge
nodes.description: Toggle to arm Cleave. Your next landed melee attack from another skill releases it toward the victim. Stays armed, with 4 seconds of recovery and 20% less damage. Each release pays the normal mana cost. Starts off.

nodes.name: Splitting Armor
nodes.description: Replace Readied Cleave’s personal damage ramp with vulnerability: after each landed hit, the target takes 10% increased damage from all sources per stored stack. Lasts 8 seconds; the maximum-stack hit benefits before clearing it.

nodes.name: Ready Rhythm
nodes.description: Odd Readied Cleave hits apply Bleed at 30% of hit damage per second. Even hits lodge 30% of physical damage as Impale.

nodes.name: Close Quarters
nodes.description: Each stack of the aimed target’s upcoming Readied Cleave hit grants 20% more radius and 20% more arc width. At the fourth hit: 80% more radius and width. Resets with the cycle.

nodes.name: Finishing Cut
nodes.description: Readied Cleave’s cycle now ends on hit 5. Ready Rhythm’s Impales wait for the finisher. The fifth hit consumes only your Ready Rhythm Bleeds and Impales on that target, dealing 150% of their remaining damage in one physical burst.

nodes.name: Unbound Cleave
nodes.description: Throw an axe for 120% more projectile damage. It lodges in the first enemy hit, holding Cleave’s recovery until you approach within melee reach. Pulling it free inflicts Bleed at 30% of the strike’s damage per second. A dead or missing target returns the axe; a missed throw recovers after 1 second.

nodes.name: Long Edge
nodes.description: The hit immediately inflicts the retrieval Bleed and grants 1 Gyre (up to 5). The axe bounces toward a nearby glyph, taking 2 seconds to land. Enter its glyph before landing to catch it and fire an 8-axe nova at half damage. Fallen axes must still be retrieved; nova axes do not lodge or bounce.

nodes.name: Wide Front
nodes.description: Each airborne catch adds a Caught Rhythm stack, up to 3. Each stack repeats the next throw once. Catching at least one axe maintains the rhythm; letting every axe land without a catch clears it. Retrieve every outstanding axe to recover Cleave.

nodes.name: Driving Front
nodes.description: While flying or bouncing, each thrown axe sheds a smaller axe in a random direction every 0.25 seconds, at 18% damage. These smaller axes inherit projectile investment but do not lodge, bounce or shed more axes.

nodes.name: Heavy Wave
nodes.description: The main thrown axes erupt in blood on impact: enemies within 75 units take 35% of the strike’s damage and Bleed at 15% per second. Catch novas and shed axes cannot trigger this explosion.

nodes.name: Spreading Wounds
nodes.description: After a 0.25-second beat, sweep a broad strip from the opposite side while preparing the axe throw, dealing Cleave’s normal melee damage. Works on its own; with Serrated Wave, this becomes the return sweep of a back-and-forth cut.

nodes.name: Serrated Wave
nodes.description: On cast, immediately sweep a broad strip in front of you while preparing the axe throw. The sweep deals Cleave’s normal melee damage; the axe follows when the cast completes. With Spreading Wounds, a return sweep follows after a beat.

skills.name: Cleave
skills.description: A wide melee swing that deals physical damage to every enemy in the arc in front of you.

nodes.name: Flame Studies
nodes.description: 15% increased fire damage. Bonuses apply per rank.

nodes.name: Ember Satellites
nodes.description: Flame orbs circle their caster instead of flying forward. Cast one additional orb; 20% less damage.

nodes.name: Dense Constellation
nodes.description: Cast one additional orb; 10% less damage.

nodes.name: Passing Embers
nodes.description: Orbs pierce two additional enemies.

nodes.name: Broad Embers
nodes.description: 50% increased projectile size and 20% increased damage.

nodes.name: Searing Orbit
nodes.description: Hits gain 35% additional chance to burn.

nodes.name: Clinging Cinders
nodes.description: 40% increased fire ailment magnitude and 25% increased duration.

nodes.name: Wildfire Sparks
nodes.description: Burns spread when their victim dies.

nodes.name: Cinder Lance
nodes.description: Flame bolts pierce three additional enemies and fly 30% faster; cast 15% more slowly.

nodes.name: White Heat
nodes.description: Penetrate 10% fire resistance.

nodes.name: Focused Flame
nodes.description: 30% more damage at 15% more mana cost.

nodes.name: Incandescent Point
nodes.description: 10% additional critical chance and 30% critical multiplier.

nodes.name: Slow Combustion
nodes.description: Hits gain 30% additional burn chance and 35% increased fire ailment magnitude.

nodes.name: Lasting Cinders
nodes.description: 40% increased effect duration.

nodes.name: Far Flight
nodes.description: 40% increased projectile speed and 20% increased damage.

skills.name: Firebolt
skills.description: Loose an orb of flame: a projectile dealing fire damage, with a 12% chance to set the victim burning.

nodes.name: Practiced Invocation
nodes.description: 15% increased working damage. Bonuses apply per rank.

nodes.name: Prismatic Script
nodes.description: Schoolless spells cycle Ember → Rime → Arc, advancing from the most recent rune in that alphabet. An empty weave starts with Ember. Each spent rune adds 15% to the release multiplier.

nodes.name: Broad Strokes
nodes.description: 30% increased working radius.

nodes.name: Fluent Words
nodes.description: 30% increased Invocation cast speed.

nodes.name: Vivid Words
nodes.description: Landed workings gain 30% chance to stun.

nodes.name: Long Sentence
nodes.description: Hold two additional runes, up to the global capacity limit of ten.

nodes.name: Sharp Inflection
nodes.description: Gain 8% working critical chance.

nodes.name: Economical Words
nodes.description: 30% reduced Invocation mana cost.

nodes.name: Patient Script
nodes.description: Schoolless spells keep banking Glyphs. Every spent rune adds 30% to the release multiplier; the working deals 15% less damage. Save a longer sentence for the larger payoff.

nodes.name: Deep Script
nodes.description: Landed workings lodge 25% of their physical hit damage as impale.

nodes.name: Break the Seal
nodes.description: Ignore 20% of enemy armor.

nodes.name: Forceful Punctuation
nodes.description: Gain 30% chance to stun.

nodes.name: Room for a Thesis
nodes.description: Hold two additional runes, up to the global capacity limit of ten.

nodes.name: Ready Conclusion
nodes.description: 40% increased Invocation cooldown recovery.

nodes.name: Words Returned
nodes.description: Leech 6% of working hit damage as life.

skills.name: Invocation
skills.description: Carried on your bar, fire, cold, or lightning casts bank Ember, Rime, or Arc. Schoolless spells such as Warp and Rune of Power bank a Glyph of raw force; channels weave one rune per held second. Casting consumes the whole sequence: the combination and its order choose the working, the closing rune sets the element (Glyph releases physical spell damage), and every rune spent makes the release stronger.
